exclusive_gpu: all timings serial; no other GPU compute process (checked with nvidia-smi before every run)
optimizer_constraint: Optax stays the default and extensible; CuTe Adam is not used as the default because of poor extensibility

fixed_count.protocol: benchmarks/fixed_model.py, 1,000,000-row bicycle PLY padded to 1,000,064, _DSC8679.JPG 822x1237, SH3, 8,000,000 pairs, 30 warmup + 300 timed updates; baseline and new rounds interleaved
fixed_count.baseline_runner: git archive 8becbae src benchmarks, run with PYTHONPATH=<snapshot>/src

full_training.protocol: jaxgs-train, images_4, resolution -1, eval true, seed 0, 1,000,000 slots, 8,000,000 pairs, 169 training views, 177 epochs; timing excludes preload, warmup and checkpoint write; 25 held-out views via benchmarks/evaluate_protocol.py
full_training.note: a second before_tile_sort run overlapped source edits and was discarded

step_profiles.protocol: 1,000,000-slot pool with 10% or 100% of the bicycle PLY alive (random subset, Morton reordered), 22 views (every 9th), one jax.profiler trace over 22 steps, Optax, no statistics

kernels_us.protocol: fixed-count view 0 inputs, jax.profiler traces of 20 calls per sample, 3 interleaved samples, medians of the summed matching kernels

identity_vs_baseline.cause: float transposed-butterfly sums instead of shared-exponent integer redux; LiteGS's xor order for half2 color sums; approximate reciprocals in the SSIM partials; atomic order

litegs_parity_note: benchmarks/packed_parity.py --output <scratch>; every field is equal to or closer to LiteGS than benchmarks/results/packed_parity.json

validation.lint: ruff check, ruff format --check and git diff --check passed
validation.compute_sanitizer: restricted to kernel_cutlass: racecheck no hazards, synccheck 0 errors, memcheck no device errors (7 host cuGetProcAddress_v2 returns)
